110-SECOND GUIDED INVESTIGATION

Record dissolved and remaining masses. Distinguish transient residue, excess of a soluble solid and a practically insoluble sample. Repeat at a lower dose or with more water before concluding.

Four separate samples at25°C. Guide 1.5× model time; manual 1×. Rates are illustrative, not measured. Rounded reference aggregates and additive volume layout; no real solution-volume measurement. Drag to orbit; scroll to zoom.
